scenes.en: So when should you check their eyes?
scenes.say: Kids rarely say they can't see. They think blurry is normal. So when should you check their eyes?

scenes.en: A newborn's eyes are checked before going home.
scenes.say: Number four. At birth. A newborn's eyes should be checked before going home from hospital.

scenes.en: Both eyes should move together and follow objects.
scenes.say: Number three. Around six to twelve months. A check that both eyes move together and follow objects.

scenes.en: Catches lazy eye and squint while they're easiest to treat.
scenes.say: Number two. Before school, between three and five years. This is when lazy eye and squint are easiest to treat.

scenes.en: A child's power can change quickly.
scenes.say: Number one. Every year during school. A child's power can change quickly, especially with lots of screen time.

scenes.en: Most vision problems in kids cause no pain. Only an eye test finds them.
scenes.say: Did you know? Most vision problems in children cause no pain at all. Watch for sitting close to the TV, squinting, or a tilted head.

scenes.en: A white glow in the pupil in photos, or an eye that suddenly turns.
scenes.ta: புகைப்படத்தில் கண்மணியில் வெள்ளை ஒளி – உடனே மருத்துவரிடம்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently if you see a white glow in your child's pupil in photos, or an eye that suddenly turns.
